Action: ## Test Article Landing Page Metadata and Affiliations Display
Ensure there is a publicly available article in DOAJ with multiple authors, where at least one author has multiple affiliations and an ORCID iD.
Navigate to the article landing page at /article/<article_id> or search for the article on /search/articles and click on its title

Expected Test Results: The article title is displayed prominently at the top
The journal title is displayed and links to the journal Table of Contents page
The list of authors is displayed
Publication date, volume, issue, and page numbers are displayed if provided
DOI and Full-Text URL links are displayed and active
Abstract and Keywords are displayed if provided

Action: Click on the "Affiliations" button/accordion under the authors list

Expected Test Results: Each author is listed with their respective affiliations
Authors with multiple affiliations display each affiliation on a separate line
Authors with ORCID iDs display a clickable ORCID icon/link to their ORCID profile

Action: ## Test Article Page Citation and Export
Navigate to an article landing page at /article/<article_id>
Locate the citation / export options on the page
Click on the RIS export option

Expected Test Results: An .ris file is downloaded containing the article's bibliographic metadata (including title, authors, affiliations, journal, publication date, and identifiers)

Action: Click on the BibTeX export option if available

Expected Test Results: BibTeX formatted citation data is displayed or downloaded

Action: ## Test Admin Edit Article Button on Article Landing Page
Log in with an admin account
Navigate to an article landing page at /article/<article_id>

Expected Test Results: An "Edit this article" button is displayed near the top of the page
The Admin Article Metadata form for this article opens in a new tab with the article's data pre-filled

Action: Log out of the admin account and view the same article landing page as an anonymous user or publisher

Expected Test Results: The "Edit this article" button is not visible
